lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Halo's still up. Half this bar works at Meridian and tonight not one of them will admit it, and tomorrow they'll all go back in.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: There's a woman in the corner who taught four of us to read a weights file properly. She'll sit with your lot if you ask her, and that's not nothing — she doesn't sit with people.
